description: This source file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. The activity displays a home screen with a top menu and multiple content rails populated from an API via a ViewModel. It handles UI setup, focus animations for D-pad navigation, image loading with Coil, and navigation to other activities.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity representing the home screen on an Android TV app, displaying menus and content rails.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and triggers setup of menus and content rails.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation menu with focus animations and click listeners.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Programs the content rails, observing ViewModel state to populate items dynamically.
